throughline.zh: 本週台灣半導體與伺服器供應鏈公布先進封裝、機櫃供電、矽光子測試及廠房建設資訊；新投資統計、產線復工與廠區施工事件則分別揭示資金與營運狀態。
throughline.en: This week's Taiwan disclosures span advanced packaging, rack power, photonics test and facility projects, alongside new investment statistics, a fab restart and a construction-site incident.

title.zh: 先進封裝、晶圓製程設備與資安驗證
title.en: Advanced packaging, wafer equipment and cybersecurity

summary.zh: 精材與台積電先前簽訂先進封裝 oS 產線外包協議，日月光路竹廠一期啟用、二期動土。11 月 16 日漢測新增與 ficonTEC 的矽光子測試合作，嘉晶公告復工出貨，數產署則公布 SEMI E187 設備資安交流。
summary.en: Xintec previously signed the CoWoS on-substrate outsourcing agreement and ASE reported Luzhu construction milestones. On November 16 Hermes expanded photonics test collaboration, Jiajing reported restarted shipments and Taiwan's digital agency summarized SEMI E187 outreach.

title.zh: 伺服器電源、光互連與連接器供應鏈

summary.zh: 技嘉與光寶科前幾日公布伺服器營收及 800VDC 進度，正文另提供高速光模組出貨目標。11 月 16 日貝爾威勒披露高電流連接器財報及 800VDC、EBO 產品規劃，產品成熟度仍需個別核對。
summary.en: Gigabyte, Lite-On and Gemtek reported server sales, 800VDC development and optical delivery targets earlier in the week. Bellwether added November 16 results and interconnect roadmaps without product-specific accepted shipment totals.

title.zh: 半導體產值、DRAM 供應與工廠營運
title.en: Semiconductor output, DRAM supply and factory operations

summary.zh: 工研院與模組廠此前披露半導體產值統計及 DRAM 配貨安排。11 月 16 日美光台中廠施工工區發生承攬商工安事故，停工限於該工區，未公告整座記憶體廠停產。
summary.en: ITRI and memory suppliers had published semiconductor-output data and DRAM allocation commentary. A November 16 fatal contractor accident at Micron halted the affected construction zone only, without an announced fab-wide shutdown.

title.zh: 製程感測、儲能 PCS 與工廠供電
title.en: Process sensors, PCS storage and factory power

summary.zh: 日月光化學感測採購、燿華宜蘭廠表後儲能工程已在本週先前公布。熙特爾與 GE Vernova、SK On 於 11 月 16 日公告 PCS、LFP 電池與在地製造合作 MOU，尚未公布正式採購金額。
summary.en: ASE's chemical sensor purchase and Unitech's Yilan storage project were previously reported. Xitel's November 16 MOU with GE Vernova and SK On concerns PCS, LFP batteries and integration, without binding procurement values.

title.zh: 海外供應鏈、資本流向與算力政策
title.en: Cross-border supply chains, capital flows and compute policy

summary.zh: 本週先前已發布元太觀音場址交易、神基工業電腦專案與衛星運算模組送樣。11 月 16 日經濟部發布前十月對台與對外投資統計，國科會公布算力池使用者及應用數，核准投資與實際機房容量分別標示。
summary.en: Earlier reports covered E Ink's site acquisition, Getac's industrial projects and satellite-compute samples. MOEA added January–October investment statistics and NSTC disclosed compute-pool users and applications on November 16, separating approved capital from installed compute.
